evidence.text: Aurachain provides the execution layer through which regulated institutions can transform obligations, risk signals, intelligence and AI into auditable, governed action relating to client lifecycle compliance, financial crime, fraud investigations, third-party risk and operational resilience.

Request a demo Menu Platform One platform to build, run and govern regulated work. The execution layer across your systems, your data and your obligations, with AI inside the process and governance around it. Request a demo See inside 80,000+ Registered users 300+ Mission-critical applications 99.98% Uptime SLA ISO 27001 & SOC 2 Certified One environment The process, the people doing it, and the proof it happened, in one place. Most institutions run those three across separate systems and spend the year reconciling them. Aurachain holds them together, so the record forms as the work happens instead of being assembled afterwards. Built for compliance, risk and fraud. Applied anywhere regulated work has to be proven. How the work actually runs A signal arrives, a process picks it up, a person decides, and the record closes. Four things make that happen. Orchestration engine Runs the process end to end and holds the state of every case. AI agents and assistants An agent completes a step on its own. An assistant helps a person complete theirs. Human in the loop Your teams decide and record why. No AI runs a critical process alone. Decisioning and rules Thresholds, routing and approvals are configured, and change in hours. AI in the platform Build it yourself, or have your agent build it. Intent AI opens the platform to your own AI agent through MCP. Ask for an application and it assembles one, carrying the same permissions, versioning and audit trail as anything built by hand. A person reviews it. A person deploys it. See how AI works in the platform What an agent can assemble Process diagram Screens Data model App variables Catalogs Functions AI agents APIs Documents Everything in the platform Nothing is handed to a separate tool, and nothing leaves the audit trail. Build One environment for every part of an application, by hand or through your agent. Visual Process Designer Draw the process, it becomes the engine Experience Designer The screens people work in Data Models Hold what no core system holds Intelligent Documents Generated from the case record Reusable Components Build once, reuse anywhere Integrations Connect the systems you already run Explore build → Use Your teams act on what the agents prepared. The record writes itself as they go. Task Screens Everything a case needs, in one place Process Live View Where every case stands right now Custom Data Views Cut the queue the way your team works AI Task Assistant Prepares the step, the person decides Explore use → Architecture No model lock-in, no system lock-in, no rebuild when you scale. Model agnostic Change provider without touching the process System agnostic Core banking, ERP, CRM, document stores Cloud native Containerized, self-healing services Enterprise scale Cloud, private or on-premise, multi-region Explore architecture → Govern Every action taken by a person or an agent is recorded as it happens. Every change to an application is versioned and reversible. Auditability Every action recorded as it happens Security and access Permissioned to field level Enterprise governance One control set, every application Observability What ran, what stalled, what changed Explore govern → Governance belongs to the platform, not to the project. Every application built on Aurachain inherits the same controls on day one. Nothing is bolted on per project, nothing negotiated per team. Audited on day one Permissioned to field level Versioned and reversible Reportable to a regulator Built to pass the review before you ask for it. The questions a security reviewer opens with, answered before the call. Cloud, private cloud or on-premise deployment Containerized architecture, scales with usage Okta, Azure AD, SAML and OAuth Full controls in the Trust Center SOC 2 certified. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified. Trusted by regulated institutions across US, Europe, Africa and the Middle East Built on Aurachain, running in production Different obligations, different teams, one platform underneath. Client lifecycle compliance Onboarding, ongoing due diligence, watch list filtering and adverse media in one case. SME lending Application through to decision, with the credit file assembled as the case moves. Letter of guarantee issuance Drafting, approval and issuance with the document generated from the case record. Negative news review Screening hits triaged, investigated and dispositioned with the rationale recorded. NAV review Month-end review with every check, exception and sign-off held in one place. Lease approval Approval routing across parties with the audit trail written as it runs. FAQ Questions we get asked Is this a development tool or an application my teams use? Both. Applications are built on Aurachain and run on Aurachain. The people doing the work log into the same platform the application was made in. Do business users build without IT losing control? Permissions, audit logs, versioning and publishing approvals are enforced by the platform. IT sets them once and every application follows them. Does it replace our core systems? No. It sits above them as the execution layer. Core banking, ERP, CRM and document systems stay where they are and connect through the integration layer. Aurachain also has its own data model and data store, so an application can hold data that has no home in an existing system. Can AI build an application on its own? It can assemble one. It cannot deploy one. Everything Intent AI produces enters the same review and approval path as work built by hand. How long before something is live? Applications go live in days, and change in hours when regulation moves. Which model does the AI run on? Whichever you choose. The platform is model agnostic and the provider can change without touching the process. Go deeper Release notes What shipped this quarter, and what changed in the platform. Trust Center Certifications, controls and the answers your security review needs. Technical walkthrough Forty minutes with an engineer, on your process, not a canned demo. Request a demo See it in use 01 Build Build it with AI, or build it yourself. 02 Use Agents carry the work. People decide. 03 Govern Every action is controlled and recorded. 01 · Build Fast to build. Just as fast to change. One application holds everything the process needs: the steps, the screens, the data, the documents, the integrations and the AI agents. Build it with AI Describe what you need to your own agent through Intent AI. Or build it yourself Visual builders for the process, the screens, the data and the documents. Change it as you go Changing what is live works exactly like building it. Configured, not coded. When the rule changes, the process changes in hours, not in the next release. How applications are built 02 · Use From request to resolution. A clear path through the work, screens people understand without being trained on them, and analytics that answer the question before anyone has to build a report. STEP 01 The request enters A connected system opens the task, or a person does. The data comes with it. STEP 02 AI agents carry the work Agents read the documents, check them against your rules and draft the assessment. STEP 03 People take the decisions Anything that carries consequence goes to a person, to approve, reject or override. STEP 04 The task closes with evidence Everything that happened is already on the record when the task closes. Task AC-40912 · live Task opened from core system 09:12:04 Documents extracted and indexed 09:12:41 Agent assessment drafted 09:14:08 Awaiting reviewer decision 09:14:09 Reviewer decision recorded 10:02:55 Task closed with full record 10:03:12 AI agent Person System Use is more than working the tasks My tasks Everything assigned to a person, with status and deadline, and an AI assistant inside the task. Process Live View Every running instance in real time: who is working on what, what is delayed, what is idle. Insights and reports Dashboards for each team, and your AI agent can turn a question into a report you can export. AI agents are governed execution objects in your workflows. What using an Aurachain application looks like 03 · Govern The same controls apply to every application, from build to production. Access is set by role. Every action, by a person or an agent, is logged as it happens. Changes are versioned, approved before publishing, and reversible. Audit trail Real-time logs of every action, ready to export whenever they are asked for. Access control Permissions down to field and action level, through your identity provider. Organisational structure Your hierarchy mirrored in the platform, so work is delegated with oversight intact. Change control Version history, approval before publishing, and rollback when you need it. Inside a single task Task AC-40912 · Closed Who decided what 09:14:08 AI agent Assessment drafted, sources attached. Agent 09:41:22 System Client data retrieved from the core system. API 10:02:55 User Finding overridden, reason recorded. Override 10:03:12 Task closed Decision, reasoning and sources kept in one record. Closed Every decision traces back to the person or agent that made it, with the reason attached. How governance works Your systems It runs on the systems you already have. 01 Core systems stay the source of truth Activity in another system can start a process, and updates are written back, through integrations with the systems you already run. Nothing has to be replaced. 02 Your identity provider, your access rules Employees sign in with the company credentials they already use. 03 Your choice of deployment Run it in the cloud or on-premises, on a platform certified to ISO/IEC 27001, and SOC 2. What moves onto Aurachain is the work that lives in spreadsheets and inboxes today. Where it runs Before you ask Questions that decide it What is Aurachain? Aurachain is the execution layer where regulated institutions turn obligations, risk signals, and fraud alerts into governed, audited action. Do we replace the systems we already run? No. Aurachain reads from your core and legacy systems, which stay the source of truth. What moves is the work currently happening in spreadsheets and inboxes. What is Intent AI? Intent AI connects your own AI agent to Aurachain through MCP. You describe the application in plain language and your agent builds it with the same modules your teams use. Your people review the result before anything goes live. Where does AI stop and people take over? AI agents do the reading, checking and drafting. Decisions that carry consequence go to a person, who can approve, reject or override, and every step is recorded in the same task. How is this different from a general-purpose application platform? Governance is part of the platform. Audit trails, approvals, permissions and version control are inherited by everything built on it. Is this only for compliance teams? No. It is for any process that has to hold up to scrutiny, which in a regulated business is most of them. What happens when a rule changes? You change the process under version control. The previous version is kept and the change is on the record. From intelligence to action. Build the operating layer for compliance, risk and fraud. Orchestrate what matters. Protect what counts.
